Commentary.Commentary: The target is a big one but the way South Africa have batted through out this series, they will fancy their chances. The wicket is a touch slow so their batting against the new ball will be key. Sri Lanka on the other hand will expect a lot from Akila as one would believe he would be the one getting the most assistance from the surface. Will the Proteas register the highest chase on this ground or will Sri Lanka finish this series on a high? Join us to find out.

The South African bowling was once again not up to the mark. Their pacers struggled with the new ball and leaked runs at the start. Maharaj though was the pick of the bowlers. He not only picked up the crucial wicket of Kusal Mendis but also applied the breaks on the scoring. The problem though was he lacked support. Rabada had a decent outing but one would expect more wickets from him. Dala too was on the expensive side. Mulder and Phehlukwayo did take two wickets each but they were taken for quite a few runs.

Post that partnership, Mathews got to his fifty and then put the foot on the accelerator. He started hitting boundaries at ease and he along with Thisara added the 4th 50-run partnership of the innings with Mathews scoring 37 of them. While the two were batting the hosts looked like they would cross 300. But it wasn't to be. The fall of the hard-hitting left hander and some tight overs in between helped the visitors crawl back into the game. But a handy cameo in the end by the hero of the last game, Dasun Shanaka, has taken the home side to a total which I believe is slightly above par.

After electing to bat, the openers got them off to a brisk start adding 50. Kusal Perera departed early but Kusal Mendis along with Dickwella stitched another fifty-run stand. Both departed after getting starts and with their departure the run rate also went down. De Silva and Mathews tough did take their time but their 53-run association laid the foundation for the big hitters to come.

An excellent batting performance led by the Sri Lankan skipper who was unfortunate not to get to a well-deserved ton has come to an end. He walks off to a standing ovation as Sri Lanka will surely be the happier of the two sides heading into the break.

OUT! Mathews doesn't get it. But a very good innings from him. Rabada goes length on middle and leg. Mathews heaves this over mid-wicket and finds Markram in the deep. They take a run. Akila sets off for the second but is sent back by his partner. De Kock does well to take off the bails and Dananjaya is well short. Sri Lanka end on 299/8 after their 50 overs.
Short ball again, Dananjaya pulls it uppishly over square leg for just a single. One ball left and Mathews needs four runs to get to a ton.
FOUR! It all counts! Another short ball outside off, Dananjaya looks to cut it but gets a top edge over the keeper's head. No third man and the ball crosses the ropes.
Short ball on middle, Mathews pulls it towards cow corner for just one. He gets off strike. Will he get to the three-figure mark?
Wide! Misses his line and darts this down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Akila Dhananjaya walks out to the middle.

OUT! Rabada gets his first. Slow ball on  middle and leg, Shanaka looks to loft it but finds Duminy at long on who makes no mistake. Good cameo from Dasun. They cross and Mathews has a chance to get to his ton.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mathews punches it through covers to get off strike.
Dala continues his short ball plan. Mathews hits it to cow corner to retain strike for the last over.

FOUR! Excellent from Mathews! This is now his highest score here in Sri Lanka. Gets behind this short ball and pulls it through mid-wicket. Bisects the fielders in the deep and the ball meets the ropes.
Shanaka plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Well fielded! Mulder this time on the ropes. The short ball ploy once again. Mathews slaps it through extra cover. Mulder at the boundary dives and keeps it to two.
Length ball down the leg side , Mathews tucks it fine down the leg side for another run.
Played to mid-wicket region by Dasun. One run added to the total.
Leg Bye! Short ball again. Shanaka tries pulling this one too but gets hit on his arm. They pick up the run as the ball goes to the off side.
Short ball around off, Mathews pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. One run added to the total. A leg bye signalled by the umpire.

Four Byes! Some chin music for the batsman! Rabada digs this one short. Shanaka ducks under it. De Kock jumps high but cannot get to the ball. The ball races away to the third man fence. Welcome runs for the hosts these.
SIX! Huge! Shanaka happy to take on the bowlers now. Rabada bangs this one short on the leg stump. Dasun pulls it with disdain over the deep square leg region for a biggie.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! 15 from the over! The best one so far of the Sri Lankan innings.  Another short ball on middle and off, Shanaka pulls this behind square to get back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Shanaka cuts loose now! Gets in position and pulls this short ball to cow corner. Maharaj dives but cannot stop the ball from hitting the fence. Should have done better.
Cutter outside off, Mathews cuts it to Amla at backward point and changes ends.
Slower ball in line of the stumps, Shanaka chips it over the bowler's head for one.
Fuller ball outside off, Mathews drives it past mid off to get off strike.

FOUR! A low full toss outside the off stump. Mathews in the form he is in, times his drive to perfection. The sweeper cover cannot get to it and the ball touches the fence. Good start to the over for the hosts.
Full toss on the pads, Mathews flicks it wide of the backward square fielder to retain the strike.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. They pick up a single.
Slow short ball down leg, Mathews pulls it to square leg to rotate strike.
Finally a run in this over. Shanaka finds the gap through mid-wicket and gives his skipper the strike.
Another dot ball. Slow ball in line of the stumps, Shanaka hits it to mid on.
Full and on middle and leg, Shanaka cannot find the gap and finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Driven towards the mid off region. 5 runs and a wicket off this over. Good one for the visitors.
Dasun Shanaka walks it to bat.

OUT! Perera holes out trying to increase the scoring rate. Slower full ball outside off, Perera makes room and looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it towards Hashim Amla at point. He takes it with ease and Sri Lanka lose the big-hitting Perera. He could not make much of an impact today and this can surely make a difference of at least 15 runs to the final total.
Full and wide outside off, Mathews drives it to wide mid off for a run. With this now, he becomes the leading run-scorer of the tournament. Also the fourth 50-run stand of the innings comes up.
Wide! The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Mathews. The umpire signals a wide.
Perera makes room and pulls it towards mid-wicket. Reeza runs to his left and puts out a dive to restrict it to a run.
Brilliant fielding from Reeza! Mathews makes some room and smashes it towards extra cover where the fielder dives to stop it. Only a run taken. Saved at least a couple of runs for his side there.
Short ball outside off, pulled along the turf to long on for just one.
Yes he does! Bowls this full outside off, Perera drives it to long off for one. A very good over from Dala.
Bangs this one short outside off, Angelo pulls it through mid-wicket for just a single. Just four runs off it, can he end it well?
Length ball outside off, Mathews dances within his crease and hits it to the off side. Dot ball.
Length ball outside off, Perera goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge towards point for another run. So far so good from Dala, just the three singles.
Another slower ball around off, Mathews tucks it away to square leg for one more.
Comes in from round the wicket and bowls this one slow. Perera eases it to extra cover for a single.
Junior Dala to bowl at the death.
FOUR! Hammered! He is sighting the ball like a football now. Dances down the track, Andile sees that and so he bangs it short. Mathews pulls it hard through mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Hit through point for a run.
On the stumps, Mathews hits it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard! It is raining boundaries here for Mathews. Short and outside off, Angelo flashes it through point and the ball races away.
Shortish again on off, Mathews slaps it to covers. 2 dots in a row.
Good length on off, Mathews drives it to the man at covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on.
Back of a length on middle, Mathews punches it down to long on and keeps strike. 10 from the over.
Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Perera tucks it around the corner with the angle for a run. Doing the smart thing is the southpaw. Just taking the singles and giving the strike over to Mathews.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Power! On the shorter side, Mathews pulls it over mid-wicket and the ball goes to the fence like a tracer bullet.
Length ball on off, the batsman hits it down to long off for a run.
Sees Mathews dancing down the track and shortens his length, Angelo hits it down to long on for a run.
Smart batting by Perera! With soft hands he works it through square leg and runs the first one hard. They go for the second and complete it easily as the fielder misfields.
Hits it towards the covers. The fielder there makes a half stop and a run is taken.
SIX! BOOM BOOM GOES AM! A drag down by Duminy. Mathews has all the time in the world to go down on one knee and slog it over the mid-wicket fence.
Flatter outside off, Perera hits it through covers and takes a run.
On the stumps, kept out.
Got to his fifty now and has started to play some shots. Goes for the slog sweep but finds the fielder at long on. Only a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders can now be outside the 30-yard circle till the 50th over.

Nope, Mathews is happy to hit it down to long on and get to his half ton. His 37th in ODIs. Another good innings by the skipper, however, he will have to stay there till the end if Sri Lanka want to get close to the 300-run mark.
Full and on off, the batsman drives it to covers. 2 dots in a row. Big shot coming?
A yorker outside off, the batsman jams it out to the man at covers.
Streaky runs. Sri Lanka won't mind. On a length and around off, Mathews tries to defend but gets an outside edge down towards third man for a couple.
Perera slaps it through covers and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, Mathews guides it down to third man for a run.
Very full, almost a yorker. TP jams it out. Just two from the over.
Just a single now as AM eases it down to long on for a run.
3 dots in a row as Angelo works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Quicker outside off, this one stays a touch low and beats the bat of Mathews as he goes to cut.
Flatter on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Full on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a run. 200 up for Sri Lanka, 12 more overs to go.
FOUR! Not farfetched if you play such shots. UFFF! Dances down the track and just smashes it over the bowler for a boundary. A good way to end the over. 7 and a wicket from it.
Fuller on off, this one straightens after pitching. Mathews tries to defend but gets an outside edge to point.
Thisara Perera strides out to bat next.

OUT! In the air... taken! So South Africa continue taking wickets at regular intervals. Mulder gets his second as another Sri Lankan batsman walks back after getting a start. The slowness of the wicket does de Silva in here. Mulder bowls it just ahead of a length on off, Dhananjaya tries to go downtown but the ball stops into the surface. He only manages to hit it up in the air towards mid off where Reeza runs back and to his right, calls mine and takes it. Sri Lanka now have half their side back in the hut. 300 now looks a little farfetched.
On the pads, de Silva flicks it through backward square leg for two.
Good length on off, Mendis goes back and blocks it.
Length ball on middle, Mathews punches it down to long off for a run. So the hoodoo is broken, this stand crosses the 50-run mark.
Willem Mulder to bowl.
Fires it on the stumps, de Silva works it to mid-wicket. So a better over from Duminy. Just a run from it.
On the stumps, de Silva goes for the sweep but mistimes it towards short fine leg.

A ball bowled with a round-arm action on off, Mathews tries to tuck it away but gets a soft leading edge towards short third man for a run. Another 50-run stand comes up. They need to go for a little more longer and probably step on the accelerator now.
Tosses it up outside off, AM punches it back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, Mathews punches it to short mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on off, worked to mid-wicket.
Quicker and outside off, de Silva goes for the cut but misses. End of Maharaj's spell, an excellent one. His figures read 10-0-32-1.
Goes back and pushes it to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
With the angle works it to mid-wicket.

SIX! BANG! The first real bad delivery by Maharaj and he has been dispatched over the ropes for the first maximum of the innings. It is a half-tracker on middle, de Silva goes back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. Also, this is the first boundary on Maharaj's bowling, it comes in his last over.
Flighted ball on off, kept out.

FOUR! Save yourself Duminy! That has been hit with tremendous power. Mathews uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. He smashes it towards Duminy who jumps out of the way and a boundary results.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Smart bowling! Bowls it slower through the air on the leg side. De Silva makes room and tries to flick but misses.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Slower through the air on middle, de Silva tucks it around the corner and runs two.
Works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
Quicker one outside off, de Silva looks to cut this past the short third man fielder but hits it to him.
Sri Lanka rotating the strike well here. Dhananjaya drives this to long off for one more.
Gives this air in line of the stumps, Mathews pushes this past the bowler to rotate strike.
Short and wide this time, de Silva cuts it past backward point for a run.
Flat ball on middle and off, Dhananjaya rocks back and hits it to mid-wicket.
Short ball on leg, Mathews punches this to long on and jogs to  get to the other end.
Drinks!
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

FOUR! First boundary of a spinner in the Sri Lanka innings. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, de Silva gets behind the ball and sweeps this through square leg. The ball races to the boundary. The umpire signals four runs.
Deft!  Dhananjay opens the face of the bat and plays this very late to third man. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

Stifled appeal from the payers but the umpire says height! Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Dhananjaya gets on one knee and looks for the swipe. He does not make contact with the ball and it goes on to hit his arm. They appeal but the umpire says no.
Angelo works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.
JP Duminy is called to bowl his first over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another classic delivery! Bowls this on middle and leg, Mathews closes the bat face early and looks to flick this away. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards backward point.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Mathews is solid in his defense.
Turns his bat to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Short and flat around off, Dhananjaya cuts it past backward point for a run.
Slower ball on middle, Dhananjaya comes down the track and blocks it out.
Length ball on leg, hit for the mid-wicket fielder to collect.
Dhananjaya opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Played to the point region by Angelo. They pick up a single.

FOUR! SHOT! An important one. And the boundary has come after almost five overs. Dala digs this one short too on middle and off, Mathews gets behind the ball and pulls it through mid-wicket. Boundary.
Dhananjaya guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Dala continues to bowl short, Mathews pulls it through square leg for one.
Slower this time in line of the stumps, de Silva blocks it out.
Beauty! Quicker ball from Maharaj down the leg. Dhananjaya is forced to go onto his back foot and gets a bottom edge to this one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Another short ball around off, de Silva stays inside and pushes this through point. They pick up a single.
Goes back and punches this ball through covers. They cross.
Gets behind the ball and whips this through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Another shot ball on leg, pulled to mid-wicket for nothing.

Ohh! What happened there? Dala targets the rib cage of Dhananjaya. De Silva goes for the pull but gets hit on his body. The ball rolls past the stumps and away from the keeper. They take the run and the umpire says it has come off the bat.
Mathews plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SHOT! Dala once again bowls it on that shorter length, Dhananjaya stands tall and just punches it through covers. Andile mops it up in the deep. The batsmen pick up three.
Another similar ball around off, Dhananjaya turns this bat to the leg side.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Dhananjaya taps it in front of him.
Junior Dala to bowl.
Another dot to end! Just 2 from the over as Mathews strokes it to covers.
Gives it air on off, Angelo finds mid off with his drive.
Flatter on off, AM drives it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, Mathews with the turn drives it to covers.
Eases this down to long off for another single.
Floats it up on off, pushed to covers for a run.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. One run added to the total.
Excellent delivery! A yorker outside off, Mathews jams it out towards point.
NO BALL! Rabada has overstepped now. Third Free Hit coming up as this ball is driven to mid on.
Slower delivery on the fuller side on off, Mathews drives it to covers.
Fuller again on off, Mathews strokes it back towards the bowler.
Dhananjaya has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Goes back again and drives this through cover-point. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rocks back and pushes it past covers to get to the other end.
De Silva comes ahead and defends it getting behind the ball.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks out to the middle.

OUT! Gone! Keshav Maharaj strikes! Maharaj gives this air outside off, Mendis comes forward to drive it. The ball turns after pitching and takes the outside edge. The keeper moves to his right and takes a good catch. They all go up in unison and the umpire raises his finger. Once again, just as the partnership was building, South Africa strike. Mendis walks back after getting a start.
Short ball in line of the stumps, punched off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Mathews is looking in fine touch. Another excellent shot. Full and on middle, Mathews uses his wrists and whips it through mid on. Once again the timing is brilliant.
Shortish on off, AM pulls it in front of square and takes two.
Back of a length on off, Mathews pushes it to covers.
Works it with the angle through square leg.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Length delivery on off, defended.
Works it against the turn through mid-wicket and a run is taken.
Slightly shorter this time, Mendis goes back and cuts it through point for a run.
Lovely stuff! Slows this up and lands it on middle, it pitches and turns. KM gets behind the line and blocks it.
Flighted ball on off, Mendis prods and keeps it out.
Flatter on off, Mathews pushes it down to long off for a run.
A friendly full toss but Mendis finds the deep square leg fielder with his sweep. Only a run.
Good length again outside off, Mendis waits and then plays it down to third man and takes a run.
Back of a length on middle, Mathews tucks it around the corner and takes one.
FOUR! Lovely! How good was that! Not a lot wrong with the delivery. On a length and around off, Mathews stands tall and strokes it on the up through mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, AM keeps it out.

Good length outside off, Mendis is unsure whether to leave it or to play at it. He in the end decides to leave it but is too late to do so. The ball hits the bottom of the bat and goes down to third man for a run.
Kagiso Rabada is brought in for another spell.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Floated up on the stumps, kept out.
Driven down to long off and a run is taken.
On the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Eases this down to long off for a run.
A little turn there. Flighted ball on off, this one pitches and turns. Mendis lunges and tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man for a couple.
Ends it with a dot! Once again it is on a fuller length and on off, AM drives it to mid off.
Goes full again and Mathews this time mistimes it to mid on.
FOUR! Again this has been timed really well and once again Andile pays the price for bowling it too full. On off, Mathews strokes it past mid on and the ball races away.
Fuller again on off, Mathews tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid off.
Fuller on middle, Mathews strokes it to mid on.
Uppish but short! On a length around off, Mathews strokes it on the up towards covers who stops it.
Brilliant over from Keshav. Just 2 of it. Gives this air outside off, Mendis drives it to covers.
Loopy ball around off, Mendis is solid in defense.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and on the pads, flicked away around the corner to get off the mark straightway.
Gets low and pushes this ball to long off for one.
Tossed up ball on leg, Mendis prods forward and blocks it.
Angelo Mathews, the skipper walks in next.

OUT! Another stand which has been broken immediately after reaching the 50-run mark. Andile Phehlukwayo provides the breakthrough as Dickwella perishes 7 short of a half century. This one is short and outside off, Andile might have bent his back on this one as it skids through. Also it is a little too close to cut. Dickwella still goes for that shot but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of de Kock who completes his second catch.

Shorter on middle, the batsman pulls it through square leg for a run. 50-run stand up between the two. A vital one, they joined association when the team had lost two quick wickets and now have steadied the ship. Sri Lanka would want them to continue.
Good comeback by the bowler! On a length and around off, it pitches and straightens. Mendis plays inside the line and gets beaten.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This time he pays the price for bowling it too full. On middle, Mendis times it straight down the ground and there is no stopping that.
FOUR! Not the ideal length on this wicket. Short and on the body, it sits up to be hit. Mendis pulls it through backward square leg and the ball races away.
Fuller in length on middle, Mendis works it to mid-wicket.
The arm ball on middle, Dickwella against the angle works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter on off, Dickwella slaps it to covers.
Nicely floated up on off, Mendis leans into it and drives it through covers for a run.
Works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Uses his feet and works it to mid-wicket.
Tosses this up on off, a little too full. Dickwella drives it back towards him.
Keshav Maharaj is into the attack.
Length ball outside off, Mendis leans ahead and cuts it behind backward point. The third man fielder runs to his right and keeps it to two.
Comes ahead to this ball and pushes it towards mid off.
Down the leg side again, flicked away past square leg for one.
Bowls this short on the leg side, Dickewlla tucks it towards fine leg for a brace.
Back of a length ball around  off, punched to covers.
FOUR! What a start after drinks! Short ball on middle and leg, Dickwella pulls it with control through square leg to the fence.
Drinks!
Better from Mulder, on a length and around off, the batsman keeps it out.
FOUR! The key here was he picked the length early. On the stumps, Mendis whips it through the vacant mid-wicket region and another boundary results. 30 is now the partnership between the two.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.
On a length around off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
On middle, tucked to the man at mid-wicket.
Just a single of the Free Hit! Another wide delivery, this time it is inside the tram line. Mendis gets an outside edge down to third man and a single results.
WIDE! The Free Hit continues! Full and wide outside off, Mendis cannot reach it.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Down the leg side, Mendis flicks it fine down the leg side and gets a boundary. Free Hit now coming up.
Shorter and on off, Mendis pulls it through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, Mendis drives it towards mid on where the fielder dives to his left and stops it.
Nicely bowled! A dipping slower ball full toss on middle, Mendis is early into the flick shot. He gets a leading edge to mid off.
FOUR! This should get him going! A wide ball on off, Mendis leans into it and drives it through cover-point. The timing is such that the ball races away.
Slower ball on off, Niroshan pushes it towards mid off and goes for a run. The fielder there misfields but no extra runs conceded.
Fuller and on middle, Dickwella drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on middle, Mendis tucks it around the corner with soft hands and runs two.
Length again on off, Mendis blocks it out.
Good length again on middle, Mendis tucks it to mid-wicket.
Pushes this through covers and takes one.

OHHHH! Cut him into half there! On a length and around off, this one comes back in. Dickwella tries to work it across the line but the ball sneaks through between bat and pad and goes just over the stumps.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, kept out. Good start by Andile, he concentrated on bowling a tight line and ended up bowling a tight over.
Fuller on off, eased through covers for a run.

Almost drags it on! Dickwella had no clue where the ball was. Back of a length on off, it comes in with the angle. Dickwella tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge which bounces just before the stumps and then goes towards the keeper.
Good length again on middle, Mendis pushes it towards mid on and runs a single.
Shorter in length on off, Mendis works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Good length on off, Mendis defends it to covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo is into the attack.
A dot to finish as Dickwella tucks it to mid-wicket.
On middle, worked with the angle to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Not learning here are the South African bowlers. They are just bowling to the strength of Dickwella. Short and wide outside off, Niroshan hops and guides it over point. It is in the gap and a boundary results.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. Two runs added to the total. The umpire signals leg Byes.
Back of a length on off, Dickwella punches it down to mid off.
Dickwella makes room and Mulder follows him. Dickwella pushes it to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis jumps and bunts it down.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Pitches it up fuller this time outside off, the ball keeps low and Mendis plays it towards point.
Back of a length ball on that fourth stump line, Dickwella hops a touch and guides it through point to get off strike.
Length ball around off, Dickwella hits it past the bowler to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Dickwella cuts it to point.
Also, Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders can now stand outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! DROPPED, NO TAKEN! South Africa get another in quick succession. Perera just can't believe what he has done here. He gets a nothing delivery, short and outside off. He would cut that to the boundary 9 out of the 10 times but this time he hits it uppishly towards the man at covers. Klaasen there drops it on the first attempt but hangs onto it on the second. Mulder pumps his fist in delight as the dangerous Perera walks back cheaply. South Africa end Powerplay 1 on a high and they would now look to apply the breaks on the scoring as well.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Down the leg side, Perera tickles it fine past the short fine leg fielder and fetches himself a boundary. Second from the over, this is turning out to be another expensive one.
Way down the leg side, it maybe the slower one which came out wrong. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on off, Kusal defends it.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
FOUR! A freebie! Short and outside off, Dickwella pounces on the width offered as he slams it over point for another boundary. His 3rd as he moves onto 25.
On the pads, Perera flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
This time there is enough room on offer as Kusal cuts it over point. Not off the middle though but enough to get three. So 8 runs do come from the over but an important wicket also.

In the air... but does not carry! Perera has to consider himself very lucky there. Dala bowls a short ball which just never arrives after pitching. Perera goes for the cut but the ball hits the splice of the bat and lobs towards mid off. The fielder there comes in but collects it on the bounce. Dala easily could have had his second.
Down the leg side, Perera tries to flick but the ball hits his pads and goes towards the keeper who does well to collect it with the dive.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Dala draws first blood, his first wicket in ODI cricket. The change of ends works wonders for him. On a length and around off, this one pitches and then straightens. Tharanga pokes at it and gets an outside edge which goes low towards de Kock who completes a good catch. A much-needed breakthrough for South Africa as Tharanga walks back after a good opening stand.
Kusal Perera is in at no.3.
WIDE! 50 up courtesy the extra. It is down the leg side and it has been wided.
FOUR! Exquisite! This time Dala tries to repeat what he did on the last ball but bowls it a touch fuller. Tharanga leans into it and times it through cover-point.
A good start by him! Bowls it just behind a fuller length, inviting the batsman for a drive. Tharanga obliges but gets beaten.
Junior Dala is back on. Change of ends for him.
A dot to end another good over for Lanka. Dickwella works it to the man at mid-wicket.
JUST OVER! Tharanga would have had his heart in his mouth as and when he hit that. On the pads, Tharanga flicks it just over the leaping mid-wicket fielder for three.
Back of a length on off, Tharanga chops it to the off side.
Slightly short again on off, Tharanga cuts it but finds point.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Knew there was no third man in place and he picked his spot to perfection. Also poor bowling by Mulder, he bowls it short and outside off, Tharanga just waited for the ball to come to him and guides it through gully for a boundary.

EDGED BUT SHORT! The bowling change almost does the trick. On a length around off, this one pitches and straightens. Tharanga hangs his bat out and gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to widish first slip.
Willem Mulder comes into the attack.
Shortish and outside off, Dickwella cuts it through backward point and runs two. Another good over for the Lankans, runs starting to flow now.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Full and wide outside off, Tharanga slashes at it, the ball takes the outside edge, goes down to third man and a single results.
A bouncer! The batsman evades it.
Pure timing! Back of a length and offers a little width outside off, Dickwella goes back and strokes it through point and some good running helps them take three.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it closer to the off pole. Dickwella pushes it to covers.

FOUR! Delightful! Tharanga gets into the act now. A half-volley outside off, Upul says thank you so much as he caresses it through covers and fetches himself a boundary. Third for the over and 13 runs come off it.
Shortish again outside off, ND guides it through point for a run.

FOUR! Up and over! Second boundary in the over! Top shot! Full and on the pads, Dickwella flicks it over mid-wicket. The fielder from mid on gives it a chase but finishes second best. Dickwella now getting into his elements.
Goes short again, Dickwella is hurried into the stroke as he pulls it to mid on.
Shortish again outside off, no bounce on this one again. Dickwell chops it to point.
FOUR! The wait is over! That has been hit with authority! Dala pays the price for bowling it too full, Dickwella smashes it past the bowler and there is no need to run for those.
A dot to end! So the wait for a boundary off the bat continues as Tharanga lets this ball outside off go.
Slightly short on off, Tharanga guides it to point.
Dickwella guides this down to third man and gets to the other end.
Back of a length again on middle, ND defends it.

Was there an edge? Well the umpire does not feel so as he has signaled it as BYES. Shorter in length on middle, Dickwella again goes for the upper cut but misses. De Kock jumps but fails to collect it cleanly and the batsmen run two. De Kock has been a touch sloppy until now, not something you expect from him.
Short and wide outside off, Tharanga normally feeds on such deliveries but this time he gets it too close to third man and only a run results.

A brace to end! A bumper on middle, does not bounce a lot. Dickwella goes for the pull but gets it off the inner half through square leg. The outfield seems to be a touch damp and hence only a couple results.
Bowls it on the stumps and Dickwella works it to mid-wicket. Just a single from the over so far.

Good shot but no runs! Fuller in length outside off, Dickwella leans into it and strokes it right off the middle towards covers. Klaasen there does well to dive to his left and make a good stop. Not able to get away are the Lankans here.
Bowls it tight, closer to the off pole. Niroshan can only guide it to point.
Edged but a run! Outside off, Tharanga goes for the drive but gets an outside edge down to third man. The batsmen cross.
Hits the length hard on off, Tharanga keeps it out.
On the stumps this time, ND blocks it. End of another good over by Rabada. He seems to be in good rhythm today.

Beaten for the second time in the over! Once again excellent use of the angle. Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on off, this one pitches and moves away. Dickwella again goes for the drive on the up but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Good bumper, a surprise delivery. Dickwella thinks about playing the upper cut but he is beaten by pace.

BEATEN! Excellent use of the angle. Bowls it just ahead of a length around off, it slants away from the batsman. Dickwella tries to drive it on the up but gets beaten. The bowler appeals but he is the only one doing so.
Good length around off, kept out.

FOUR BYES! A high full toss outside off, Dickwella somehow misses it as he tries to thrash it through the off side. The ball bounces just in front of de Kock which makes it tough for him to collect. He does not and the ball goes down to the third man fence.
NO BALL! Rabada has overstepped and a Free Hit is coming up. Fuller on off, Dickwella drives it towards covers.
Good running again! When boundaries are hard to come by rotation of the strike is very important. Back of a length on off, ND drops it towards covers and gets to the other end.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Gets his line right this time and bowls it on off, Dickwella off the back foot pushes it to covers.
On the pads, Tharanga misses out on the flick. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batsmen run a leg bye. Tharanga would feel he missed out on a boundary there.
Good running! Fullish on off, Dickwella strokes it towards mid off and goes for a brisk run.
Shorter in length again, this time aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. He tucks it around the corner and gets off the mark.
False start by Dala! He bowls a bumper on off, Tharanga watches it go to the keeper and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Junior Dala will bowl from the other end.
Back to bowling it on off, Dickwella guides it to point. A good first over by Rabada comes to an end.
Uppish but safe and Sri Lanka are underway. Fullish on middle, Dickwella uses his wrists and whips it in the air but wide of mid on for a brace.
Goes fuller this time, giving the ball a little more opportunity to swing but once again no movement seen. Dickwella pushes it to the man at covers.
Lands it on a length for the third time in a row and around the off stump line. Dickwella once again keeps it out.
Hits the length hard again on off, ND is once again solid in defense. No swing for the bowler as of now, that was quite expected.
Right on the money from the pacer! On a length and around off, no swing on offer. Dickwella gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out.

We are all set for the action to begin. The South African players are in a huddle and now they make their way onto the field. They are followed by the openers, Upul Tharanga and Niroshan Dickwella. The latter will be on strike and he will face Kagiso Rabada who will start the proceedings. Here we go...

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock(w/c), Hashim Amla, Reeza Hendricks, Jean-Paul Duminy, Heinrich Klaasen, Aiden Markram, Andile Phehlukwayo, Willem Mulder, Keshav Maharaj, Junior Dala, Kagiso Rabada.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Niroshan Dickwella(w), Upul Tharanga, Kusal Mendis, Kusal Perera, Angelo Mathews(c), Dhananjaya de Silva, Thisara Perera, Dasun Shanaka, Akila Dananjaya, Suranga Lakmal, Lahiru Kumara.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat first. They are unchanged from the last game and a couple of changes for South Africa, Rabada comes in for Miller and Markram comes in for Ngidi.

The visitors on the other hand, will want to get back to winning ways. De Kock will be eyeing his first win as captain. Despite their loss, they are favorites to make it 4-1. Whatever, the result maybe, let us hope we get a game as exciting as the last one.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the last ODI of the series between Sri Lanka and South Africa. Another dead rubber, however, both the teams will still be eager to end on the winning side. The hosts have momentum on their side and they would want to end the series on a high.
